AnkiDeck.title: AnkiDeck
AnkiDeck.description: Represents the metadata for an uploaded Anki flashcard deck file (.apkg) stored in Firebase Storage.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnkiDeck entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this Anki deck.

fileName.description: The original file name of the uploaded Anki deck.

displayName.description: A user-friendly name for the Anki deck.

description.description: A brief description of the Anki deck's content.

fileSize.description: The size of the Anki deck file in bytes.

downloadUrl.description: A temporary signed URL to download the Anki deck file.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the Anki deck file was uploaded.

category.description: An optional category assigned by the user.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and settings, including storage usage metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, matching the Firebase Authentication UID.

storageUsedBytes.description: Total bytes currently used for Anki decks.

deckCount.description: Total number of Anki decks uploaded.

Habit.title: Habit
Habit.description: A recurring cognitive or wellness habit defined by the user.

HabitLog.title: HabitLog
HabitLog.description: A daily record of a habit's completion status.

definition.description: Represents a user's profile and storage metrics.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores metadata for Anki flashcard deck files.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owner.

params.name: deckId
params.description: The unique identifier for the deck metadata.

firestore.reasoning: This structure supports the Health and Wellness workspace pattern by enabling synchronized habit tracking and storage-backed knowledge management while maintaining strict authorization independence.
